standing: Leads the AFC East by 3.5 games

lastGame.title: Bills 31, Jets 12
stats: Josh Allen: 11-of-21, 196 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT; 2 rushing TDs (both 1 yard); passed Peyton Manning for most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons
James Cook III: 18 carries, 157 yards, 74-yard TD run (career long, Bills' longest rushing TD since 2016)
DJ Moore: 4 catches, 90 yards, 45-yard TD; Dalton Kincaid had a career-long 54-yard catch
Defense: no TDs allowed, Jets 3-of-13 on third down; T.J. Parker 2 sacks, Dorian Williams first career sack
Jets QBs: Geno Smith 13-of-21, 148 yards before an ankle injury; rookie Cade Klubnik 11-of-20, 137 yards, 1 INT

news.h: Reed-Adams to IR, Couch back on practice squad
news.b: On Tuesday the Bills placed rookie G Ar'maj Reed-Adams (2026 seventh-round pick, inactive for all nine games) on injured reserve. He will miss at least four games. They re-signed DB Te'Cory Couch to the practice squad and released G Nick Broeker, leaving one open spot on the active roster.

news.h: Tre'Davious White on standby for Benford
news.b: CB Christian Benford (groin) left the Jets game. If he can't play Sunday, the Bills will elevate veteran Tre'Davious White from the practice squad. Dee Alford (concussion) and LB Dorian Williams (calf) also left that game. The first practice report for the Miami game comes out Wednesday.

news.h: McCord makes second start; Bills open as 16.5-point favorites
news.b: Kyle McCord, a former sixth-round pick, makes his second start for Miami (1-8) with Malik Willis on IR. In his debut he went 17-of-32 for 209 yards and lost a fumble in his own end zone. FanDuel opened Buffalo at -16.5 with a 45.5 total, the biggest spread of Week 11.

news.h: Defense has tightened up over the last three games
news.b: After allowing 28.5 points a game through six games, Buffalo has given up 28 points in its last three, with 8 takeaways and 10 sacks. Third-down conversions allowed fell from 51% to 17.6%. Buffalo has won 10 straight home games against Miami.
